name: Engineering Deck
narrativeOnEnter: Cramped and hot. Junction box open — someone started a reroute and stopped. Wiring schematic inside the panel cover.

action.text:
LIFE SUPPORT POWER REROUTE — ENGINEERING MANUAL
Taped inside panel cover — DO NOT REMOVE

Emergency connection order:
  Red   → Junction A  (High voltage — connect first)
  Blue  → Junction D
  Green → Junction B
  Yellow→ Junction C  (Low voltage — connect last)

Incorrect wiring will trip the breaker and count as a system fault.
Complete sequence restores life support and unseals command blast doors.

ENGINEERING LOG — KOVALEV, D.

Entry 110:
'Found Synaptic Response Recorders in the reactor housing. Six of them — one per crew member.
Transmitting neural data for 63 days. Buffer is full. That's what MERIDIAN-3 is waiting for.'

Entry 111:
'Shipping origin: Δ Medical Dynamics = AXIOM Group. HELIOS GROUP = AXIOM.
This was never a science posting. We were the science.
Option: trigger a thermal event that wipes the buffer. Survivable. Probably.'

Entry 112:
'Started the thermal sequence. Alarm triggered — had to abort.
Gone to Reactor Deck to finish it.

If anyone finds this:
— Wiring schematic is on the panel
— Cargo lock sequence on the freight manifest
— Reactor sequence in the safety manual
— Pod bay code on Chen's ID

If the buffer burns: we're crew again. Not data. Not PROMETHEUS.
— D. Kovalev'
